#include <iostream>
#include <string>

using namespace std;

bool at(const string& str, int pos) {
    return pos + 1 < (int)str.size() && str[pos + 1] == 't';
}

bool dot(const string& str, int pos) {
    int len = (int)str.size();
    return pos + 2 < len - 1 && str[pos + 1] == 'o' && str[pos + 2] == 't';
}

int main() {
    string s;
    cin >> s;

    string ans;
    ans.reserve(s.size());
    ans.push_back(s[0]);

    bool replaced_at = false;

    for (int i = 1; i < (int)s.size();) {
        if (s[i] == 'a' && !replaced_at && at(s, i)) {
            ans.push_back('@');
            replaced_at = true;
            i += 2;
        } else if (s[i] == 'd' && dot(s, i)) {
            ans.push_back('.');
            i += 3;
        } else {
            ans.push_back(s[i]);
            ++i;
        }
    }

    cout << ans;
    return 0;
}

    int l = (int)s.size();
    if (i >= l) {
        return;
    }

    if (s[i] == 'a' && !replaced_at && i + 1 < l && s[i + 1] == 't') {
        cout << '@';
        replaced_at = true;
        walk(s, i + 2, replaced_at);

        cout << '.';
        walk(s, i + 3, replaced_at);
        return;
    }

    cout << s[i];
    walk(s, i + 1, replaced_at);
}

    cout << s[0];

    bool replaced_at = false;
    walk(s, 1, replaced_at);
